subject: Vendor onboarding form discrepancy — PO allocation and stub line mismatch
messages:
From: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@grayline.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, procurement@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding form submission and line-item question

Hi Mateo / Redwood procurement team,

Thanks for the onboarding call last week — attached is our completed onboarding form and the CSV of initial SKUs we intend to purchase. A couple of things we wanted to call out up front:

- We broke out services into two lines (Implementation / Monthly API). The onboarding form has a single consolidated description which I think caused your PO stub to list only one line.
- Our internal billing requires the PO to separate the one-time implementation fee from recurring spend so we can route to different cost centers.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can issue the provisional PO with two line items and a $125k annual spend cap on the API line? If you need any account codes from our side, let me know — I've attached our vendor tax form as well.

Attachments: Grayline_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf), grayline_skus.csv (csv)

Best,
Sophie Tan
Vendor Enablement Lead
Grayline Logistics
sophie.tan@grayline.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@grayline.com>
Cc: procurement@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding form submission and line-item question

Hi Sophie — thanks for sending these over and for the clear breakdown. We've looked through the onboarding PDF and the CSV. Two quick notes: 

1) We typically issue a provisional PO number while procurement finishes the vendor record — the provisional PO can include separate lines for one-time vs recurring.
2) The spend cap on recurring lines is set at account-level; procurement needs the cost-center code you want the recurring charges to bill against.

I've looped in Marissa (procurement lead) and Irene (vendor setup) to issue the provisional PO and confirm the spend cap. Marissa — can you draft the provisional PO with two line items and set the API recurring line cap to $125,000/year? Use Grayline Logistics / GL-2026-177 for the account. Sophie, if you can confirm the cost-center code (or reply with "use implementation CC: 408-IT and recurring CC: 701-OPS"), we'll lock the lines.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@grayline.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding form submission and line-item question

Hi team — provisional PO created. Details below and attached provisional PDF: PO-987654-provisional.pdf (provisional).

PO summary (provisional):
- PO#: 987654 (provisional)
- Line 1: Implementation services — Qty 1 — USD 45,000 — Cost center: 408-IT — One-time
- Line 2: API access (recurring) — Est. annual spend USD 120,000 — Cost center: 701-OPS — Spend cap applied: USD 125,000/year
- Payment terms: Net 30; Vendor tax form verified

Note: The onboarding CSV had an API estimate of $120k/year; we applied a $125k spend cap to give a small buffer while we finalize usage tiers. 

Sophie — you had asked about splitting a single-line stub. We created two distinct lines as requested. One outstanding mismatch we noticed: your CSV includes a service code (GL-API-V1) that doesn't map to our internal SKU mapping and so landed as a generic "API access" line. If you want that to be itemized into multiple SKUs (e.g., event-ingest vs semantic-index) we can re-run line-item assignment and produce a revised PO.

Attaching: PO-987654-provisional.pdf

Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@grayline.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@grayline.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding form submission and line-item question

Thanks Marissa — that helps a lot. Quick clarifying question: the provisional PO shows API access as a single recurring line with the GL-API-V1 code noted by your team as unmapped. For our internal accounting we'd prefer two recurring lines (Ingest API / Indexing API) with approximate splits (70% / 30%) so revenue recognition maps correctly across our teams.

If you can accept that split I'll provide a short CSV with the desired breakdown and cost-center mapping (both lines should bill to 701-OPS). Also — is the spend cap enforced per-line or per-vendor? We want to make sure the total across lines cannot exceed the $125k/year cap.

Attachments: revised_line_breakdown.csv

Best,
Sophie

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@grayline.com>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding form submission and line-item question

Sophie — thanks for the quick follow-up and the proposed split. We reviewed the CSV you sent and updated the PO to itemize the API line into two recurring lines. Revised PO attached (PO-987654-revised-lineitems.pdf).

Key points:
- PO#: 987654 (finalized) — we removed the provisional flag because vendor record is now complete
- Line 1: Implementation services — USD 45,000 — Cost center: 408-IT — One-time
- Line 2: Ingest API (recurring) — USD 84,000/year — Cost center: 701-OPS
- Line 3: Indexing API (recurring) — USD 36,000/year — Cost center: 701-OPS
- Spend cap: enforced at vendor-account level (total recurring lines capped at USD 125,000/year). If you need per-line caps, we can add them, but by default the cap is per vendor account.

I've attached the finalized PO and a short note describing mapping changes. Please confirm and we'll route this to Accounts Payable for the Net 30 terms.

Attachments: PO-987654-revised-lineitems.pdf, sku-mapping-note.txt

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
